thread:
derek: Heads-up: planning a quarterly least-priv sweep focused on ephemeral/admin bindings. Want to discuss sampling strategy, KMS safety checks, and automatic evidence packaging.
yana: +1. We should avoid blind removals across accounts. Proposal: sampled dry-run -> 5-project canary -> wider rollout. Keep canary small (2-5 projects).
priya: Safety checklist: (1) snapshot project IAM, (2) export KMS key IAM, (3) list bucket/object ACLs that mention the principal, (4) capture notification history, (5) bundle + sign.
derek: Can you paste example commands for snapshots?
priya: Sure:```bash
gcloud projects get-iam-policy $PROJ --format=json > $PROJ-iam.json
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/$PROJ/locations/global/keyRings/$KR/cryptoKeys/$KEY --format=json > $KEY-iam.json
aws s3api get-bucket-acl --bucket $BUCKET > $BUCKET-acl.json
# manifest + checksums
sha256sum *.json > manifest.sha256
tar czf evidence-$PRIN.tar.gz *.json manifest.sha256
gpg --detach-sign evidence-$PRIN.tar.gz
mc cp evidence-$PRIN.tar.gz s3://compliance-archive/$RUN_ID/
```
yana: Add `gcloud logging read` to capture recent Bind/Unbind activity for the principal so auditors can see intent. Also capture who acknowledged notifications.
infra: We'll add a deploy-time guard flag `--pause-on-missing-role` to infra-agent. During the canary window deploys that reference a removed role will fail with a clear error linking to the rebind procedure.
ops-oncall: Ops will run the 3-project canary Tue 01:30 UTC. We'll enable enhanced tracing and collect traces to /var/log/priv-sweep/$RUN_ID for 72h. We expect a short mitigation window (5-10m) per project.
derek: Recovery plan idea: `grant-temp --principal X --ttl 1h --reason "rollback"` that records the event with tombstone and creates a ticket. Make it scriptable.
priya: We'll include that. Also ensure `grant-temp` is audited and its invocation produces a signed artifact that goes into the same evidence tarball.
legal: Artifact format accepted: one tarball per principal with snapshots, logs, notification history, manifest (sha256), and a GPG detached signature. Retention: 7 years. Include ticket reference and a short statement in the manifest about hashing and storage.
sec-bot: IncidentBot: Created ticket SWEEP-5177 assigned to derek, priya.
derek: Action items: priya write snapshot + pack scripts (PR), infra add guard flag + CI tests, ops schedule canary and traces, legal confirm retention & ACLs. Target: dry-run Mon, canary Tue, roll after signoff.
yana: One more safety: add a pre-prune grep step to check for principals referenced inside IaC (terraform state / repo scans). If found, open owner ticket instead of prune.
priya: Good catch. I'll add `repo-scan --match-principal $PRIN` to the runbook.
derek: Thanks all. Keep updates short here and paste PR/ticket links. We'll collect the signed artifacts in s3://compliance-archive/5177/ and reference them in the ticket. :thumbsup:
